data.body: Fixed: Added NOT-flag rule #7 to reviewer-base.md requiring reviewers to read all source/. directive targets before asserting functions are undefined in bash scripts. Added MANDATORY pre-check sections to reviewer-delta-deep-correctness.md and reviewer-delta-standard.md specifically for bash source directives. Rebuilt all 10 agent files via build-review-agents.sh. The fix prevents false-positive 'undefined function' findings when functions are defined in sourced files (e.g., tests/lib/assert.sh, plugins/dso/hooks/lib/deps.sh).
